[
  {"step": 1, "file": "tests/fuzz/fuzz_compress.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 40, "var": "output", "code": "output = malloc(size + 1);", "note": "Allocates the destination buffer of size+1 = 200001 bytes. This is the heap region that will be overflowed by the write."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "tests/fuzz/fuzz_compress.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 44, "var": "data/output", "code": "blosc_compress(level, filter, 1, size, data, output, size)", "note": "Attacker-controlled 200000-byte input `data` is passed with destsize=size=200000. level=9, filter=0 (NOSHUFFLE), typesize=1, compressor=blosclz. The last min(size/4,4096)=4096 bytes of data are zeros so the entropy probe passes."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "blosc/blosc.c", "function": "blosc_compress", "line": 1399, "var": "result", "code": "result = blosc_compress_ctx(clevel, doshuffle, typesize, nbytes, src, dest, destsize, compname, g_force_blocksize, g_threads);", "note": "Forwards the compression request into the context-based compression path with destsize=200000."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "blosc/blosc.c", "function": "blosc_compress_context", "line": 1255, "var": "ntbytes", "code": "ntbytes = do_job(context);", "note": "Starts the actual compression job; ntbytes will hold the compressed byte count."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "blosc/blosc.c", "function": "do_job", "line": 914, "var": "ntbytes", "code": "ntbytes = serial_blosc(context);", "note": "Single-threaded serial compression path is taken (nthreads=1)."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "blosc/blosc.c", "function": "serial_blosc", "line": 836, "var": "cbytes", "code": "cbytes = blosc_c(context, bsize, leftoverblock, ntbytes, dest, _tmp, bsize);", "note": "Compresses the single 200000-byte block (blocksize=200000, nsplits=1, neblock=200000) into the destination."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "blosc/blosc.c", "function": "blosc_c", "line": 636, "var": "dest", "code": "dest += sizeof(int32_t);", "note": "Advances dest past the 4-byte cbytes header so blosclz_compress writes into the block payload area."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "blosc/blosc.c", "function": "blosc_c", "line": 639, "var": "maxout", "code": "maxout = neblock;", "note": "maxout is initially set to the block size (200000), the nominal output budget for this block."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "blosc/blosc.c", "function": "blosc_c", "line": 647, "var": "maxout", "code": "maxout = maxbytes - ntbytes;   /* avoid buffer overrun */", "note": "maxout is bounded to maxbytes-ntbytes = 200000-24 = 199976 to avoid overrunning the destination, but this bound is applied to the wrong base (see step 11)."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "blosc/blosc.c", "function": "blosc_c", "line": 653, "var": "cbytes", "code": "cbytes = blosclz_compress(context->clevel, _tmp+j*neblock, neblock, dest, maxout, !dont_split);", "note": "Calls the vulnerable blosclz_compress with length=200000, output=dest, maxout=199976, split_block=1."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "blosc/blosclz.c", "function": "blosclz_compress", "line": 427, "var": "maxlen", "code": "int maxlen = length / 4;", "note": "Entropy probe length is length/4 = 50000, capped to 4096 inside get_cratio."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "blosc/blosclz.c", "function": "blosclz_compress", "line": 429, "var": "shift", "code": "int shift = length - maxlen;", "note": "Probe offset is length-maxlen = 150000, pointing into the zeroed probe region of the input."},
  {"step": 13, "file": "blosc/blosclz.c", "function": "blosclz_compress", "line": 431, "var": "cratio", "code": "double cratio = get_cratio(ibase + shift, maxlen, 3, 3);", "note": "Probes the zeroed region and returns a high cratio (157.46), so the block is treated as compressible and compression proceeds."},
  {"step": 14, "file": "blosc/blosclz.c", "function": "blosclz_compress", "line": 434, "var": "cratio", "code": "if (cratio < cratio_[clevel]) { goto out; }", "note": "cratio=157.46 >= cratio_[9]=1.0, so the early-exit is not taken and the main compression loop runs on the incompressible random data."},
  {"step": 15, "file": "blosc/blosclz.c", "function": "blosclz_compress", "line": 484, "var": "op_limit", "code": "const uint8_t* op_limit = op + maxout;", "note": "ROOT CAUSE: op_limit is computed from `op`, which has already advanced 5 bytes past `output` (5 literal header bytes written above). It should be `output + maxout`. This makes op_limit 5 bytes too large, allowing writes up to 4 bytes past the end of the 200001-byte output buffer."},
  {"step": 16, "file": "blosc/blosclz.c", "function": "blosclz_compress", "line": 512, "var": "op", "code": "LITERAL(ip, op, op_limit, anchor, copy)", "note": "The LITERAL macro executes `*op++ = *anchor++` (line 249). Because op_limit is 5 bytes too large, the incompressible random data drives op past the end of the 200001-byte heap buffer, causing a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 1 at blosclz.c:512."}
]
EOF
echo "written"; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid JSON, steps:', len(d))"
